tests.title: Section B: Applied Nutrition and Dietetics (50 marks)
tests.patternSource: INC B.Sc Nursing Regulations 2020, Appendix 3 (university theory question paper pattern): Applied Nutrition and Dietetics is Section B (50 marks) of a combined 3-hour, 75-mark paper shared with Applied Biochemistry (Section A, 25 marks). No internal choice. This mock covers Section B only, timed at about two-thirds of the paper. Confirm with your university.
